runs.embedding_policy: GGUF Q6_K embedding is converted to Q8 for tied head AND input lookup by the existing dianoia GGUF importer.

comparison_scope: Exact fresh responses compared with the official GGUF reference on 7 prompts/6 images. Archived PTQ results are historical and those model weights were deleted before this run. The importer converts the Q6_K tied embedding/head to Q8; no general equivalence to untouched GGUF inference is claimed beyond these fixtures.

cleanup.retained: Configuration/tokenizer/license and test images/results; no previous VL weights or caches retained.
